import subprocess,sys,base64
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.cwd()
for page in [2,3,6,7,10]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(page),'-l',str(page),'-scale-to','1200','-png','-singlefile',str(p/'inputs/lp.pdf')],capture_output=True,check=True)
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(p/'write_lane.py'),f'visual/lp-{page}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout).decode(),text=True,check=True)
